name: Lexco Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Lexco specializes in supplying steel cable ends and wire rope cable ends for OEMs and industrial buyers who require precise, load-rated termination solutions. Each fitting is selected or manufactured based on application-specific requirements including load capacity, environment, connection type, and installation method.
about:
Lexco Cable Manufacturing operates from Norridge, Illinois, where it has produced custom wire rope, cable, and bungee cord assemblies since 1974. The family-owned company began as a specialist in load-rated termination solutions for OEMs and industrial buyers, growing into a full-service fabricator of wire rope fittings, push-pull controls, architectural cable railings, and related hardware.

The shop handles custom cut-to-length wire rope, crimping, swaging, and assembly of fittings such as end terminals, turnbuckles, and lanyards. Capabilities span prototype through high-volume runs with flexible order quantities and low minimums. Lexco's ISO 9001-certified quality system covers engineering support, first-article inspection, and traceability for aerospace, defense, and commercial programs.

Customers include military prime contractors, OEMs in fitness and agriculture, MRO distributors, general contractors, and aftermarket sellers. The company's product line addresses applications from aircraft cable assemblies meeting MIL-DTL-83420 to bungee cords for tethering and sign hanging, with a configurator that lets buyers specify diameter, construction, coating, and end fittings.

Lexco differentiates itself by combining custom fabrication with practical production support—quick turnarounds, low order minimums, and application-specific engineering. Fifty years of continuous operation under the same ownership have built a knowledge base that the company leverages to help customers select the right cable, fitting, and assembly method for each load and environment.
